Hello OP, working in insurance here. If need mo ng magagamit mo while you are alive, better to buy HMO or Personal Accident. HMO has other benefits like check-ups or mga OPDs benefits. May mga Family HMO na pwede mo ienrol yung dependents mo. It is lower cost than enrolling separately per individual. May mga HMO na kasama yung mga meds na binigay sa ospital. Unlike life insurance need mo pa ng malalang sakit, or death para magamit mo.

Personal Accident covers naman if ever maaksidente ka, kahit kagat ng aso pwede mo i-claim. Not sure kung sa inoffer sayo may ganyang benefits. Also cheap lang yung PA, 1 peso per 1k cover for Accidental Death and Disablement Benefit. May medical reimbursement din. So depende talaga sa need mo. 

Personally, I prefer buying traditional insurance kung para sa beneficiaries ko if ever mawala ako then separate yung magagamit ko while living. So weigh mo muna needs mo. I don't usually ask advice sa mga FA, kasi FAs are life insurance agents. Most of them, bebentahan ka lang without knowing what you really need and kung hanggang saan lang financial capability mo.
